base_template: On May 15, 2024, the Aerospace Division's Ground Control Systems team detected an ARP spoofing attack originating from a rogue device bypassing VLAN 40. The intrusion originated from a compromised workstation with MAC address 08:00:27:a0:7e:d1, flooding the network with falsified ARP replies to redirect traffic to an unauthorized gateway (10.45.12.1). Critical telemetry data for satellite tracking was intermittently redirected, causing temporary loss of real-time monitoring.
expected_solution: Enable 'ip arp inspection' on the affected VLAN and ensure DHCP snooping is active to provide the binding database.
